title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Flash PMI Aug: Composite 56.0 (4yr high); Services 56.8 vs 54.0 est (big beat); Mfg 53.2 vs 53.9 est
BTC $80K test rejected overnight — slipped to $77,116 (+6.5% 24h); thin weekend liquidity ahead of Jackson Hole
BTC+ETH ETFs: ~$800M inflows Aug 21 (BTC $307.5M, IBIT $239.3M) — 2nd consecutive strong inflow day
